title: A single external Alexander--Whitney cochain map
statement: For a field k, schemes f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, arbitrary open families U and V, and fixed modules F on X and G on Y, there exists a natural-index cochain map from the tensor total of the two scalar Cech complexes to the product-cover scalar Cech complex of the external coefficients [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. On each (p,q) pure tensor and product tuple, its coordinate is the tensor of the front F section and the back G section, pulled along the units of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and restricted to the product intersection, using the faces of [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. This asserts no naturality in G and no extension to integers.

proof.text: Construct each bilinear (p,q) tensor summand map using [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree], proved by existing scalar pullback coefficient maps, scalar tensor section maps and Cech categorical products.

Use mapBifunctorDesc to assemble degree maps. The adjacent differential equality [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-differential] makes them a cochain map via CochainComplex.ofHom; the complex shape supplies the nonadjacent equations. Recover each summand map with ι_mapBifunctorDesc and evaluate its coordinates, proving IsPicardExternalCechCupComponent.

proof_origin.place: Equation 33.29.1.1 and Tag 07MB: R4 proved bilinear summands and universal-property assembly, splitting off adjacent differential compatibility.

theorem picardExternalCechCupComponent_exists
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ c : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶
      (picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G),
      IsPicardExternalCechCupComponent f g U V F G c
